messages:
Lia (design): quick mobile UX q — on phones ~360px the Resources table pushes the entire page horizontally. My proposal: convert the table into a bottomsheet list on narrow widths instead of trying to squeeze columns.
Omar (frontend): +1 to bottomsheet for action-heavy rows. Less horizontal scroll. Concern: how does this interact with the persistent top toolbar?
Lia (design): idea is toolbar stays pinned (search + breadcrumbs) and table becomes a swipe-up sheet that contains rows + primary actions. toolbar height reduces to 48px at <=420px.
Jess (product): do we lose discoverability for advanced filters if they go inside the sheet? Filters are important for power users.
Omar (frontend): we can keep a condensed filter pill in the toolbar that opens the sheet with filter view. avoids two separate surfaces.
Alex (pm): important: keyboard open behavior. On some devices keyboard pushes content and the sheet can end up under the keyboard. Any suggestions?
Lia (design): for keyboard we should implement the sheet with safe-area + dynamically adjust max-height: calc(100vh - toolbarHeight - env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) and recompute on keyboard events.
Omar (frontend): implemented similar in payments app. snippet that helped:
```
.sheet { max-height: calc(100vh - 56px); overflow: auto; }
window.addEventListener('resize', recomputeSheetHeight)
```
But mobile browsers are messy; need testing on iOS WKWebView specifically.
Jess (product): copy nit: currently toolbar label "Resources" sometimes read as infra resources. Can we use "Models & Workloads" or "Compute"?
Lia (design): prefer "Workloads" — shorter. Voting: Workloads vs Models & Workloads?
Alex (pm): Workloads wins for clarity across pages.
devex-bot: FYI: usage analytics show 22% mobile sessions under 420px for this page (last 30d).
Lia (design): Accessibility nits: when bottomsheet opens, focus must move to the sheet and trap keyboard focus. Also add a visible close button and ensure 44px tap targets for rows with actions.
Omar (frontend): noted. We'll use aria-modal="true" and manage inert on background. Also will add skip link: "Skip to content" when toolbar is focused.
Jess (product): what about long table cells (IDs / hashes)? We should truncate with an inline "Show" affordance not a tooltip. Tooltips aren't great on touch.
Lia (design): agree — truncate to 24 chars with trailing ellipsis and a toggled inline expansion. For screen readers expose full text via an offscreen element.
Omar (frontend): I'll prototype the sheet and truncated rows. Plan: 1) toolbar condense, 2) sheet with rows + primary action button, 3) filter pill opens sheet prefiltered, 4) keyboard handling tests on iOS/Android.
Lia (design): timeline: prototype by Wed, handoff for accessibility review Thu. Any blockers?
Jess (product): none from product. Add me to PR for copy review.
Alex (pm): assign small UX spike to Omar for 2d. If sheet works, we'll roll to canary on mobile next sprint.
Lia (design): thanks all. posting mock in #design after lunch -> @Omar (frontend) please add the prototype url when ready. :thumbsup:
Omar (frontend): will do.
